question: Which phenomenon is opposite to solidification?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fusion**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fusion** is the process that is opposite to solidification.
 
• In **solidification**, a liquid turns into a solid. Conversely, in **fusion**, a solid turns into a liquid.
 
• Fusion is also commonly known as **melting**.
 
• This phenomenon occurs when a substance absorbs heat, causing its molecules to vibrate faster and eventually overcome the forces holding them in a solid structure.
 
• Examples of fusion include ice melting into water and wax melting when heated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sublimation** is a process where a solid changes directly into a gas without passing through the liquid phase.
 
• **Vaporisation** refers to the process of a liquid turning into a gas, either through evaporation or boiling.
 
• **Condensation** is the process where a gas turns into a liquid.
 
• Understanding these processes is crucial in fields such as chemistry, physics, and engineering.
 
• Each of these processes involves energy changes and plays a significant role in various natural and industrial applications.
